title: A Bright Bar of Light
caption: The barred spiral galaxy NGC 2217, imaged by the Hubble Space Telescope
celestial: NGC 2217 · constellation Canis Major · about 65 million light-years away (source figure)
credit: ESA/Hubble & NASA, J. DalcantonAcknowledgement: Judy Schmidt (Geckzilla)

recognition.text: ESA/Hubble Picture of the Week (an editorial selection, not an audience score).

story: A brilliant bar of light shines at the heart of NGC 2217, a barred spiral galaxy found in Canis Major, the Greater Dog. Many stars crowd into its central region to form that luminous bar, and a set of tightly wound spiral arms surrounds it.
The galaxy lies roughly 65 million light-years from Earth and, at 100 thousand light-years across, is about the same size as our Milky Way.

Bars like this one are important to how such galaxies change over time. They help channel gas from the disc toward the galaxy's center. There, the gas and dust either form new stars or feed the supermassive black hole at the core. These black holes, which range from a few hundred to more than a billion times the mass of the Sun, are found in almost all large galaxies.
scale: Using the source's listed field of view (3.32 x 3.34 arcminutes) and distance (65 million light years), the frame spans roughly 63,000 × 63,000 light-years. Its light set out about 65 million years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: The detail comes from Hubble's Advanced Camera for Surveys, using filters at 475, 775 and 850 nm, spanning visible and near-infrared light. The color was added with Pan-STARRS data, but the exact color mapping is not published.
understand.eye: Part of the light recorded is near-infrared, which the eye cannot see, and Hubble's exposures reveal detail far beyond what any eye at a telescope could pick out.

explore: NGC 2217 is also known as AM 0619-271. The color in this Hubble image was added using a ground-based survey, the Panoramic Survey Telescope and Rapid Response System, better known as Pan-STARRS.
alt: A spiral galaxy with a bright central bar surrounded by tightly wound spiral arms.
